name: dashboard-saas
description: Authenticated SaaS/dashboard archetype with onboarding, navigation, data views, settings and credible empty/loading/error states.
guidelines: Do not fill every page with metric cards; optimize around the product's primary task.
Lists and detail views need clear information hierarchy and action placement.
definition_of_done: A new user can reach a useful dashboard state after login.
Primary resource workflows include create/read/update and meaningful empty/error states.
